audience: domain owners who manage their domains and DNS zones at INWX

useCases.title: Check which domains expire soon
useCases.text: List the domains of the account with their status, expiry date and lock state. Open one domain to see its dates, renewal mode and contact handles.

useCases.title: Check whether a domain name can be registered
useCases.text: Check whether domain names can be registered now, and whether they are premium names. The check orders nothing.

useCases.title: Review the DNS records of a zone
useCases.text: List the DNS zones hosted at INWX, then open one zone to see its records with their ids, types, contents and TTL values.

useCases.title: Change the TTL or content of a DNS record
useCases.text: Read the zone to find the record id. Then change that one record. Only the fields you pass change, and the change applies to live DNS.

useCases.title: Add a new DNS record to a zone
useCases.text: Check the existing records of a zone, then add one new DNS record. The change applies to live DNS.

useCases.title: Find the contacts behind a domain
useCases.text: Read a domain to get its owner, admin and tech contact handle ids. Then open each handle to see the name and e-mail on it.
